answer: A verifiable delay function mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to solve sequential, non-parallelizable puzzles before registering. Facing a gale of fake identities, an attacker cannot distribute computation, incurring a verifiable cost in dedicated hardware time and energy per persona. Though each proof yields a verifiable pearl of elapsed execution, the system relies on an ivory assumption of hardware parity, leaving it vulnerable to adversaries using custom ASICs.
